goal: the scenario «What's in the Cellar?» (Chaosium) playable from the base, as the first work of the English series (Р-251)
extra:
## This work (Р-251, first English work of the new series)

Source: the English original `whats-in-the-cellar-en` (text layer; printed page = physical page; `python -B pipeline/source/pages.py show whats-in-the-cellar-en <page>`; check numbers on the page image `pages.py image`). Russian text — our translation (flag `translated`); official Russian forms of names and terms — glossary `python -B tools/terms.py <word>` and existing records (Р-184); new terms of this book — list them in your report for `kb-terms`.

- One `scenario` record (summary, keeper_info, hook, advice, steps with refs, conclusion with Sanity rewards, tables), every scene (`arc`), characters (stat blocks as printed, Р-25; pregenerated investigators are characters of the scenario with role pregen), creatures (known Mythos creatures → `instance_of` the shared record; a unique being — book record), items and clues, handouts (text as printed, our translation), tomes, places (New York — the shared city record `coc:location:new-york` if it exists, Grep first; the Blackwood cabin near Whitehall — under «Окрестности …» or a scenario city per Р-190/Р-209), maps (`map` records with spots on every printed label, Р-206).
- Book-scoped ids `whats-in-the-cellar-en/<kind>/<slug>` in `kb/books/whats-in-the-cellar-en/<kinds>/`.
- Pictures (skill `.claude/skills/kb-art/SKILL.md`, Р-241, Р-245): portraits, creature art, handouts, item pictures — mapping `checks/20261115-cellar/art.json`, `python -B pipeline/art/add_images.py … --dry-run` then real; apply the proposals yourself (`pipeline/integrate/apply.py`) — you own this book; atmosphere pictures → `checks/20261115-cellar/atmosphere.json`.
- Lessons from earlier checks (skill kb-import, «Ошибки, которые уже находили»): every page of an entry in `sources`; handout texts in full; maps are `map` records, not atmosphere; no two records with the same `name.ru`.
- When done, run `python -I -B tools/completeness.py --books whats-in-the-cellar-en --out checks/20261115-cellar/completeness` and `python -I -B tools/scenario_check.py --books whats-in-the-cellar-en --out checks/20261115-cellar/scenario` and fix what they find.
- Coverage: in `checks/20261115-cellar/cellar.md` list every heading of the book → the record that holds it (or «не взято» with the reason).
